test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

He writes essays on various topics _________ science and politics.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "including"** is used to introduce examples, which fits perfectly in the given sentence.
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence logically or grammatically.
 
• **"Including"** adds clarity and completeness to the list of topics the essays are about.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He writes essays on various topics** including** science and politics."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "into"** – This word does not make sense in the context of listing topics.
 
• **Option 2: "following"** – This word does not fit grammatically in this sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: "after"** – This word does not logically follow in the context of listing topics.
